issues.description: Ruff UP007/UP035/UP045 disabled wholesale with a TODO instead of executing the Union-to-pipe migration the PR claims.
issues.detail: The PR description states Union/Optional will be banned, yet ruff.toml ignores exactly those rules with 'TODO: Remove these - it's a lot of errors.' That contradicts the stated specification and leaves the codebase in a two-dialect state. Either land the auto-fix as a follow-up patch in this series or scope the ignore narrowly with a tracking link.

issues.description: default_raise() shim and stale '< 3.10 compatibility' comments left behind after kw_only_dataclass removal.
issues.detail: With kw_only=True universally available, required fields can omit defaults natively. Retaining field(default_factory=default_raise) as a required-field sentinel weakens the contract (RuntimeError at construct time instead of TypeError at the call site) and the comment above TransactionEndpointRequest still cites a precondition that no longer holds. Remove the shim or update the rationale.

issues.description: install.sh version guard still permits Python 3.7-3.9 while the error message and pyproject claim >=3.10.
issues.detail: The guard reads `PYTHON_MINOR_VER -lt 7` but prints '>= 3.10', so a 3.8 interpreter passes the check with a contradictory message. The minimum supported version is one fact; tighten the literal to 10 so the predicate matches the printed contract.

issues.description: Debug `dnf search python3.12` left in install-scripts CI prep with no assertion on its output.
issues.detail: The Amazon/Rocky prep steps run `dnf search python3.12` before install. It neither gates installation nor asserts availability; failure is ignored and success is unused. Drop the line or convert it into an explicit precondition check that fails fast when the package is missing.

synthesis.summary: The mechanical removal of Python 3.9 support is correctly shaped where it actually deletes version forks (cmd_classes.py is exemplary), but the patch is half-applied. Compatibility scaffolding — default_raise(), '<3.10' comments, and pragma-no-cover branches — is left as dead folklore even though its precondition no longer holds. More seriously, the stated specification (no Union/Optional) is contradicted by a blanket ruff ignore of UP007/UP035/UP045 with a TODO, and install.sh still permits 3.7-3.9 past a guard that claims 3.10+. Finish the ruff conversion, strip the stale shims, and tighten the install guard.
